mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message (receiver_id, sender_id, msg_type, target_id, post_id, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{msgType}, #{targetId}, #{postId}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_read = 0 AND msg_type IN (2, 3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS replies, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_read = 0 AND msg_type IN (1, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS likes FROM sys_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId}

SELECT m.msg_id AS msgId, m.sender_id AS senderId, u.nickname AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar, m.msg_type AS msgType, CASE m.msg_type WHEN 1 THEN '点赞了你' WHEN 6 THEN '收藏了你' ELSE '与你互动' END AS actionText, CASE m.msg_type WHEN 6 THEN 'favorite' ELSE 'like' END AS type, m.content AS snippet, CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS commentId, m.post_id AS postId, LEFT(COALESCE(p.content, ''), 120) AS postPreview, m.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_message m LEFT JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN forum_post p ON p.post_id = m.post_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE m.receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND m.msg_type IN (1, 6) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT m.msg_id AS msgId, m.sender_id AS senderId, u.nickname AS senderName, u.avatar AS senderAvatar, m.msg_type AS msgType, CASE m.msg_type WHEN 2 THEN '评论了你的帖子' WHEN 3 THEN '回复了你的评论' WHEN 4 THEN '@了你' WHEN 5 THEN '赞了你的评论' ELSE '与你互动' END AS actionText, CASE WHEN m.msg_type = 4 THEN 'mention' ELSE 'reply' END AS type, COALESCE(m.content, '') AS snippet, CASE WHEN m.msg_type IN (2, 3, 4, 5) THEN m.target_id ELSE NULL END AS commentId, m.post_id AS postId, LEFT(COALESCE(p.content, ''), 120) AS postPreview, m.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_message m LEFT JOIN `user` u ON m.sender_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN forum_post p ON p.post_id = m.post_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE m.receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND m.msg_type IN (2, 3, 4, 5) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
